character: Glacier skiing capital of the Alps. Europe's largest skiable glacier (summer skiing June-Sept). Legendary snowpark, lively young crowd, purpose-built.
description: Les Deux Alpes has the largest skiable glacier in Europe (6km long, 1,200m vertical) — one of the few resorts in the world with summer skiing from June to September. The resort sits on a plateau between two valleys ('Deux Alpes'), purpose-built in the 1960s but now one of the best snowparks in Europe. Lively, young, vibrant. The glacier offers year-round skiing, the snowpark is legendary (boardercross, halfpipe, kickers), and there's a huge range of non-ski activities.

stats.glacier: Largest skiable glacier in Europe (6km long, summer June-Sept)

weather_snow.season_typical: Late Nov to early May + summer skiing June-Sept
weather_snow.summer_skiing: Europe's most reliable accessible summer glacier skiing

villages.name: Les Deux Alpes
villages.character: Main resort — lively, young, purpose-built with shops, bars, restaurants along main street

non_ski_activities.jandri_3s: Brand-new flagship lift — connects resort to glacier in 17 min. France's most advanced ski lift.
non_ski_activities.ice_caves: 200m gallery 30m below glacier surface at 3,200 m. Annual ice sculpture exhibition by expert sculptors. New theme every year. €7.50/adult. Accessible via ski lift + funicular.
non_ski_activities.step_into_void: Skywalk at 3,400 m on Soreiller summit — 7m long glass platform overlooking La Selle valley 1,500 m below.
non_ski_activities.glacier_dining: Chalet de la Toura (2,600 m, sunny valley, festive atmosphere, popular, accessible to pedestrians)
non_ski_activities.ice_skating: Open-air ice rink in the heart of resort, beside Saga Centre (Rue des Sagnes)
spas: Chalet Mounier spa — Cinq Mondes certified, pool, hammam, sauna, jacuzzi, fitness
Aqua Center — indoor/outdoor heated pool, sauna, hammam, spa
dining_specific: Le P'tit Polyte — Hôtel Chalet Mounier (★ Michelin, Chef Guillaume Barengo, highest starred restaurant in Isère)
Yonder Café (health-conscious, açai bowls, matcha, avocado toast)
Le Grain de Sel (French, local/seasonal, featured on France 3)
Le Raisin d'Ours (smoked burger, homemade brioche)
Monsieur K (new, upmarket hybrid — refined cuisine, rock'n'roll atmosphere, 5pm-2am)
non_ski_activities.other: Paragliding, ice climbing, speed riding, electric mountain biking, glacier hiking with guides (from March), 70+ restaurants, night skiing on Vallée Blanche green run

honest_drawbacks: Main street can feel crowded with young crowds
Apres is fun but limited to a handful of bars
High winds can close glacier (frequent in winter)
Long transfer from Grenoble (1h45 mountain road)
glacier_note: Largest accessible skiable glacier in Europe. 6km long, up to 1,200m vertical. Open June-September. Book accommodation in June/September for lowest prices.
